question.question_text: Which item was handled more frequently by the camera wearer: the pack of grapes or the bunch of bananas?

answer_options.text: The pack of grapes was handled more frequently
The bunch of bananas was handled more frequently
The video does not show the use of a pack of grapes, only a bunch of bananas
Both were handled with the same frequency
Neither item was visibly handled; the work was done off-camera

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer handled the bunch of bananas more frequently than the pack of grapes. The bananas were retrieved from the fridge and carried towards the table. The grapes were transferred from a container into a bowl, then picked multiple times from the bowl and eaten. The bananas were handled once, while the grapes were handled multiple times during the process.

evidence_index.source_content: Camera wearer opens fridge, retrieves bananas and chocolate packet, then walks towards table.
Man transfers grapes from container into bowl on counter, then continues putting grapes in the bowl across multiple actions.
Camera wearer picks grapes from bowl multiple times and eats one grape.
